name: The Apprentice
description: A young student still learning the game's basics.
label: HIST3.1: Thebes — Apprentices learned rosette through trial and error, often favoring bold captures.

name: The Guard Captain
description: A disciplined soldier who plays with military precision.
label: HIST3.1: Thebes — Guard captains valued formation and patience, mirroring their tactics on the battlefield.

name: The Nubian Trader
description: A calculating merchant who reads opponents like ledgers.
label: HIST3.1: Thebes — Nubian traders brought rosette from their homeland, mixing Egyptian rules with African strategies.

name: The Court Sage
description: An elderly advisor whose centuries of play are unmatched.
label: HIST3.1: Thebes — Court sages treated rosette as a form of divination, each move a prophecy.

name: The Papyrus Reader
description: A scholar who memorized every recorded rosette game.
label: HIST3.1: Memphis — Papyrus readers could recall thousands of past games and applied their lessons.

name: The Loom Master
description: A master weaver who sees patterns others miss.
label: HIST3.1: Memphis — Loom masters translated textile patterns into rosette strategies, creating unexpected combinations.

name: The Pyramid Builder
description: An engineer who approaches the board like a construction project.
label: HIST3.1: Memphis — Pyramid builders planned rosette moves in layers, each piece a stone in a grand design.

name: The Vizier's Apprentice
description: A rising star in the vizier's court, hungry for recognition.
label: HIST3.1: Memphis — Vizier apprentices played rosette to prove their worth, often taking bold risks.

name: The Aten Priest
description: A religious devotee who sees divine patterns in every roll.
label: HIST3.1: Akhetaten — Aten priests believed the dice were guided by the sun disc itself.

name: The Sun Painter
description: An artist who paints the board as a living landscape.
label: HIST3.1: Akhetaten — Sun painters saw rosette as a meditation on light, each piece a ray of the Aten.

name: The Heretic Scholar
description: A rebel thinker who challenges traditional strategies.
label: HIST3.1: Akhetaten — Heretic scholars broke centuries of convention, creating new strategies that shocked traditionalists.

name: Akhenaten
description: The Pharaoh himself — a master strategist said to play with divine insight.
label: HIST3.1: Akhetaten — Akhenaten's rosette games were said to be guided by the Aten, making him an undefeated opponent.
